name: IWL World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Made history in September 1997 when the Empress of Darkness became the fed's own first-ever female World Champion, and closed the surviving record on Spazzz after a December title change at the Winter Washout.

name: IWL Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Held by Dale D'Amico into late October 1997 -- who refused the fed's own Most Hated Wrestler award on-air rather than accept it -- before moving to The Capitol at the BarbWire Blitz supercard and staying there through the surviving record's end.

name: IWL Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Vacated by Deathcall in the fall of 1997 and picked up by Fire Mexica in December, who held it through the surviving record's end.

name: IWL World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Traded twice across the surviving record between the same two teams, The Merry Men and The Super Powers, with The Merry Men back on top by the record's own end.

name: IWL Television Championship
epitaph: Changed hands twice across the surviving record's final months, from Estrago through Savage Steele to Terrier Tim Larson, and stood vacant at the record's own end.
